subject: Follow-up: Pioneer Labs — startup incentive & $/1M token target
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Alice Gomez <alice.gomez@pioneerlabs.ai>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jan 2026 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: Follow-up from today's demo — high-level econ & next steps

Hi Alice,

Thanks again for your time today. Quick recap from our call and two asks so we can fast-track an initial commercial proposal: 

1) Confirmed product scope: generation API for chat + embeddings for semantic search (2 models, primary + fallback).
2) Target performance: p50 latency <= 120ms, burst to 50 RPS.
3) Usage profile (high level): mostly short chat responses (~120 tokens avg) with periodic long-context retrieval (1–2% > 1k tokens).

As discussed, the two things we'd like from you to put a startup-incentive first-pass offer together:
- A 3–6 month expected burn range (tokens / month) or an example monthly spend target (even a range is fine).
- Confirmation that Pioneer Labs is eligible for a startup program (seed/series A + less than $3M ARR) — if you can confirm company stage we can apply the right discount tier.

Ben and Dylan: please see Alice's signal on budget below and propose a $/1M token target range we can offer under a 6-month commit vs a 12-month commit. Also attaching the standard startup_terms.pdf for transparency.

Next step: Alice, if you can reply with a ballpark monthly token burn and stage, we'll follow up with two pricing scenarios (starter commit + multi-year incentive) by end of week.

Thanks,

--
Soojin Lee
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com
Redwood Inference
From: Alice Gomez <alice.gomez@pioneerlabs.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Pioneer Procurement <procurement@pioneerlabs.ai>
Date: Fri, 16 Jan 2026 09:17:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up from today's demo — high-level econ & next steps

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for the clear recap — appreciate it. A few quick notes from our side: 

- Company stage: Series A (closed last quarter), ARR ~ $900k. I can share a doc if you need official confirmation for the program.
- Expected token burn: we expect ~120M tokens/month in months 2–6 after rollout; month 1 will be a ramp month at ~30M tokens. Those estimates assume ~0.5M chat sessions/month with the avg 120 tokens you mentioned.
- Budget: leadership gave us a working target of $7k–$12k/month for infra during the pilot, but they said they could stretch for a committed discount if unit economics hit the right $/1M token.

Two asks from our procurement side: 1) can you provide an illustrative $/1M token under the startup program for a 6-month commit vs 12-month commit, and 2) any limits on token overage charges?

I'll attach a short company stage proof in a separate email (cc procurement).

Best,
Alice
Head of Product, Pioneer Labs
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Alice Gomez <alice.gomez@pioneerlabs.ai>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Jan 2026 10:33:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up from today's demo — high-level econ & next steps

Hi Alice — appreciate the numbers, that helps a lot.

I pulled together two illustrative scenarios based on your 120M/month steady state (120 tokens avg) and the pilot ramp: attached is a one-sheet (pioneer_usage_projection_q1.xlsx) with the math. Highlights below: 

- Baseline hosted retail-like unit (no commit): equivalent to ~$1,800 per 1M tokens (this is our on-demand reference).
- 6-month committed use (tiered band for 120M/mo): we can offer $1,200 per 1M tokens effective rate, plus a 20% starter credit applied to the first two months' invoice as a pilot incentive.
- 12-month committed use (multi-year incentive): we can offer $950 per 1M tokens with a step-down rebate at 9 months if actual burn meets the 120M/mo target.
- Overage policy: overages billed at the committed rate for the exceeded tier for that month; we provide a 10% grace buffer for initial 2 months of ramp.

Caveats: these figures assume standard quantization and batching profiles and that Pioneer is willing to allow Redwood to apply prefix/KV caching. If tighter data residency or no-caching restrictions are required, the unit price steps up ~15–25%.

Next steps: 1) Soojin, can you confirm which of these scenarios you'd like me to formalize into a quote? 2) Alice, if Pioneer is comfortable with the 6-month test, we can deliver a draft commercial term sheet and a DocuSign link by Wed.

Attaching: pioneer_usage_projection_q1.xlsx and the startup_terms.pdf Soojin referenced.

--
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
From: Alice Gomez <alice.gomez@pioneerlabs.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Pioneer Procurement <procurement@pioneerlabs.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Jan 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up from today's demo — high-level econ & next steps

Ben / Soojin,

Thanks — that's a helpful breakdown. Pioneer is inclined to start with the 6-month committed test at the $1,200 / 1M token effective rate with the 20% pilot credit on months 1–2. Procurement would like the following clarified in the term sheet: 

- Explicit overage mechanics and notification cadence (we want a weekly usage alert once we hit 80% of committed band).
- A short SLA clause for p50 latency target and a remedy credit if p50 exceeds 200ms for more than 72 hours in a rolling 30-day window.
- Confirmation that the 20% starter credit applies before tax/VAT and is visible on the invoice.

If you can include those three items in the draft term sheet and DocuSign by end of day Thursday we'll route for quick approval.

I'll also upload the proof-of-stage doc to the Drive link you shared.

Best,
Alice
Head of Product | Pioneer Labs
